title: Credit reporting dispute – Chapter 13 dismissal – loan ending 0004
correspondence_text:
To Harbor Point Mortgage Services:

This firm represents your borrower, Gregory P. Lindqvist, regarding the mortgage loan on his home at 1146 Quarry Hill Road, Ashby Mill, DE 19707 (loan number 0099000004). Mr. Lindqvist's signed authorization is attached. Please direct all communication about this loan to me and do not contact Mr. Lindqvist directly.

Mr. Lindqvist filed a Chapter 13 case in the United States Bankruptcy Court for the District of Brandywine, Case No. 24-10382. The court dismissed that case on July 14, 2026. No discharge was entered. A copy of the order dismissing the case is attached.

Mr. Lindqvist's September credit report shows your mortgage account as discharged in bankruptcy. That does not match the court record. We dispute the accuracy of this reporting. Please investigate, correct your records as needed, and send me a written response with the results of your investigation.

Sincerely,

Monica A. Ferrante
Ferrante & Hale, LLC
Attorney for Gregory P. Lindqvist
(302) 555-0148
concerns: Counsel disputes the credit reporting of the mortgage account as discharged in bankruptcy
Reconcile the court's dismissal order (no discharge) with the discharged bankruptcy status in servicing records

documents.title: Order Dismissing Chapter 13 Case – No. 24-10382
paragraphs: Upon consideration of the Chapter 13 Trustee's Motion to Dismiss for failure to make payments under the confirmed plan (Docket No. 81), and after notice and a hearing held on July 9, 2026, at which the Debtor did not cure the default, it is hereby ORDERED that:
2. The Debtor has not received a discharge in this case, and no order of discharge shall be entered.
3. Any order directing an employer to deduct plan payments from the Debtor's wages is terminated.
4. The Chapter 13 Trustee shall file a final report and account. The Court retains jurisdiction to consider the Trustee's final report and any timely application for compensation.

documents.title: Authorization to Communicate Through Counsel
paragraphs: I, Gregory P. Lindqvist, am the borrower on the mortgage loan identified above. I have retained Ferrante & Hale, LLC to represent me regarding this loan, including my dispute of how the loan is reported to the consumer reporting agencies following the dismissal of my Chapter 13 case.

I authorize Harbor Point Mortgage Services to discuss this loan with my attorney, Monica A. Ferrante, and to release to her any information about the loan that she requests. I ask that you send all correspondence about this loan to my attorney at the email address below and that you do not contact me directly while I am represented.
This authorization remains in effect until I revoke it in writing.
